title.narrative: UNICEF combined service delivery with private-sector solutions to protect children's right to safe WASH. Thousands gained access to climate-resilient WASH, schools and health facilities were solarized, and UNICEF mobilized private financing for solar-powered water systems, strengthening markets, safety oversight, and emergency response for children affected by climate shocks and conflict.
